title: Light gray is too blue
text: Light gray is too blue. Replaced my light gray bath rug with this one.  This color is what I would call "light blue" not "light gray", though it looked ok in the picture.  The dark gray would have been too dark.  I'll keep it because it's too much trouble to do a return.
